title: Dutch banks increasingly push customers towards smartphone banking, watchdog warns
title_zh: 监管机构警告：荷兰银行正日益推动客户使用智能手机银行服务
description: The Consumers' Association has warned that Dutch banks are making it increasingly difficult for customers to manage their banking without a smartphone.
description_zh: 消费者协会警告称，荷兰的银行正在让客户越来越难以在没有智能手机的情况下管理银行业务。

title: Consumers cut spending at bars and restaurants as price hikes and heat take their toll

description_zh: 据荷兰餐饮服务协会（FSIN）称，荷兰消费者在夏季减少了在酒吧和餐馆的支出。

title: Dutch consumers less enthusiastic about Black Friday
title_zh: 荷兰消费者对“黑色星期五”的热情不高。
description: For the first time, Dutch shoppers are showing less enthusiasm for the Black Friday sales event.
description_zh: 荷兰消费者对“黑色星期五”促销活动的热情首次下降。

title: Dutch PM Jetten voices support for Denmark after alleged Russian plot to murder rapper

description: Dutch Prime Minister Rob Jetten said Friday that the Netherlands stands with Denmark after Copenhagen accused Russian intelligence of trying to assassinate an American-Ukrainian rapper and blogger,
description_zh: 荷兰首相罗布·杰滕周五表示，在哥本哈根指责俄罗斯情报部门试图暗杀一名美籍乌克兰裔说唱歌手兼博主后，荷兰与丹麦站在一起。

title: Woman, 64, whose car went into Amsterdam canal, died hours later
title_zh: 一名64岁女子驾车坠入阿姆斯特丹运河，数小时后不幸身亡。
